_comment: Shared by generate_site.py (feed.xml) and the custom-products feed functions.
Edit here only — both readers load THIS file, so the two feeds cannot drift.
placeholder_image_patterns: case-insensitive regex fragments matched against
the image URL. Google disapproves images carrying logos, watermarks or
'coming soon' text as 'Promotional overlay on image'. There is no valid cover
to submit for these, so the whole item is skipped rather than earn an
item-level disapproval that drags on account-wide Shopping quality.
The ChatGPT_Image_May_25_2026 fragment matters: the 99 Bookstore
'IMAGE COMING SOON' card (competitor logo + 'LEARN MORE, GROW MORE') was
re-uploaded to Shopify under generic filenames like
ChatGPT_Image_May_25_2026_03_28_31_PM_<uuid>.png, which none of the
word-based patterns match. 2,238 custom_products rows carry it; on
2026-08-09 Google flagged 61 of them. They were only kept out of the feed by
the catalog tag filters — an untagged product with that image would have
gone straight in.
excluded_slugs: products whose image is a genuine policy breach and for which
no clean replacement exists yet. Remove a slug once its image is fixed.
Merchant Center caps g:id at 50 chars, so what an issue report calls the
Product ID may be a TRUNCATED slug. Readers must test both the slug and the
truncated feed id — the Elle Kennedy combo is exactly that case.

excluded_slugs.ink-chai-library-box-52733: Marketing creative, not a product shot: '10 BOOKS FOR Rs 999', 'FREE BOOKMARKS', '3 FREE POSTERS', '1500+ 5-STAR REVIEWS', plus a 99BOOKSTORE logo on the box. Price and promo text in an image is an unambiguous breach. Needs a plain product photo.
excluded_slugs.contemporary-glamour-opulent-interiors-f: Uses the 99 Bookstore 'IMAGE COMING SOON' placeholder — the only one that reached the main feed. Needs a real cover.
excluded_slugs.the-deal-the-mistake-the-score-elle-kenn: Amazon 'prime' badge on The Deal cover — a third-party promotional badge, not part of the printed cover art. Needs a re-shot combo image.
Same product as above, listed under the 50-char TRUNCATED g:id that Merchant Center reports as its Product ID.
